correctness.rationale: The eight-dimensional Pauli characteristic polynomial factors exactly into a two-dimensional reflection-odd block and a cubic in squared energy from the six-dimensional even block. The cubic discriminant is 65536 times the stated polynomial D. Exact signs D(0,z)>0, D(z,z)>0 and D(z+1/4,z)<0, plus Descartes sign changes and D(u,z)~16u^3, show two simple positive roots with the smaller in (z,z+1/4). Root continuity and F(0;u,z)<0 prove full spectral reality precisely to the smaller root; above, a nonreal squared-energy pair or two negative roots exclude all-real eigenvalues. The resultant of D and partial_z D factors into positive factors times a cubic with a unique positive zero. Exact endpoint expansions force a unique global minimum. The packaged symbolic checker reconstructs the full matrix and independently evaluates all polynomial identities. The zero-field case is treated separately; numerical decimals are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The central site of a three-spin open Ising chain is the smallest physically meaningful interior localized exceptional impurity. The exact complete field-dependence of the all-real spectrum and its unique optimal destabilizing field answer a natural control question not answered by the published numerical longer-chain plots. The positive universal-in-field threshold, explicit sharp bounds, and weak/strong-field limits provide a quantitative finite-size benchmark. The significance attaches to the whole sharp phase portrait and minimization, not merely to calculating an arbitrary finite determinant or listing a decimal.
